explanation: By definition, a tree with $V$ vertices has exactly $V - 1$ edges. For $V = 5$, edges = 4.

An equivalence relation must be reflexive, symmetric, and transitive. The identity relation and universal relation satisfy all three properties. An irreflexive relation can never be reflexive, so it cannot be an equivalence relation.
The power set of a set with $n$ elements contains $2^n$ elements. For $n = 3$, the size of the power set is $2^3 = 8$.
